cells.b_solo_current_reused: m = 7 to 10 from the registered §12.2 ladder screen, read only

decision_rule.FAIL: any model has no in-band rung at m <= 12
decision_rule.MARGINAL: every model has an in-band rung and at least one sits within one standard error of a band edge; a fresh-topic confirmation is then required before any grid amendment
decision_rule.PASS: every model has at least one m in the screen grid inside the registered focal band under the floored stem, and that rung sits MORE than one standard error from both band edges
decision_rule.fixed_before: the first generation of this screen
decision_rule.no_extension_past_12: the grid is not extended past m = 12 to obtain a pass; a model needing m > 12 is reported as the finding
decision_rule.standard_error: topic-clustered bootstrap standard deviation of the compliance estimate, 2000 resamples over the 24 topics

grid.rule_unchanged: longest alphabetic run at most m letters; only the severity range is extended, inside this screen only

extension_at_m11: Every word in the answer must have at most 11 letters.
Use only words of 11 letters or fewer.
Do not use any word longer than 11 letters.
No word in your answer may exceed 11 letters.

prior_prediction.known_bias: on gemma-3n-e2b-it the pooled figure ran about 0.09 above the direct measurement, so the prediction is treated as optimistic and the realised gap is reported
prior_prediction.source: the FORM x STEM screen's pooled extrapolation

payload.question: Under the current stem, honest B-solo compliance is 0.000 on qwen3-4b and 0.042 on qwen3-4b-instruct-2507; the apparent ~0.75 is carried entirely by sub-twenty-word answers. Under the floored stem both Qwens exhaust the registered focal grid m in {7,8,9,10}. Does an honest focal severity exist at m <= 12 on all four models?
readouts: smallest in-band m, its distance from each band edge, and a topic-clustered standard error on that compliance

registered_values_untouched.note: listed so a later diff proves the screen changed none of them
